annotation.description: There is a mean sitting on red couch in front of class balustrade. In the background is an open space with people walking there. He wears a blue shirt, black belt and blue jeans. We cannot see his feet. He has short light brown hair, no beard and wears classes. He moves his hands quite a lot while talking to the camera but moves his right hand more. On his right hand he wears a ring on the ring finger. The light is really white/blueish
